g.aria-label: Title text 'D12, MVA-only eight: injected lag-only load-shift, -50% of capacity for 15 days (October 2025) Only the lag inputs carry the shift, so the black dashed line (the observed power) is the NRA. Dark band: q05-q95. Light band: q01-q99. Grey shade: the shift in the lags. Day-ahead forecasts issued at 09:00 the day before; mean of two seeds and two refits. Median: line.'

text.font-family: Matter XH, DM Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: D12, MVA-only eight: injected lag-only load-shift, -50% of capacity for 15 days (October 2025)
Only the lag inputs carry the shift, so the black dashed line (the observed power) is the NRA. Dark band: q05-q95. Light band: q01-q99. Grey shade: the shift in the lags.
Day-ahead forecasts issued at 09:00 the day before; mean of two seeds and two refits. Median: line.
